title: 第013章 黑毛怪藏夜哭祸迷途灵宠寻故人第014章 隘口藏奸施暗计妒兄设伏害琴姬
content_zh:
落云村的风波彻底平息，三名作恶的散修不敢有半分懈怠。
按着蔡文姬定下的规矩，在王磊的看管下逐门逐户归还抢夺的钱粮物资，对着村民躬身致歉。
往日里凶神恶煞、抬手便打的恶人，如今低眉顺眼、小心翼翼，连大声喘气都不敢。
村民们积压多日的怨气尽数消解，看向青衣少女的目光里，满是感激与敬畏。
不少老人家特意取出家中仅剩的粗茶、野果，执意要送给蔡文姬聊表谢意。
蔡文姬一一婉拒，她下山本就是为了除恶安良、积累功德，并非贪图凡人的半点回馈。
王磊在一旁帮着婉拒村民的馈赠，笑着解释道：
“诸位乡亲不必客气，斩妖除魔、护佑百姓本就是我们修仙者的本分，这些东西你们留着补补身子就好。”
蔡文姬则安排三名散修开始清理村落里残留的邪祟浊气，又叮嘱他们往后半年安分劳作、赎罪悔过。
王磊特意留下一道传讯印记，沉声道：“我会定期回来巡查，若是你们敢阳奉阴违、再作恶事，不用蔡师妹动手，我第一个废了你们的修为。”
三名散修连连点头，哪里还敢有半句反抗。
就在众人以为万事大吉、准备散去的时候，之前拄着拐杖哭诉的老奶奶却迟迟没有离开。
她拉着蔡文姬的衣角，脸色煞白，嘴唇哆嗦着，眼神里满是未散的恐惧。
蔡文姬蹲下身，柔声问道：“奶奶，还有什么事吗？是不是还有难处没说？”
老奶奶左右看了看，确认王磊把三个散修押去村边看管，正在极速往回折返，才压低声音，带着哭腔凑到她耳边：
“仙长……还有……还有一个更可怕的东西……它不是那三个坏人，是个会吃人的夜哭怪……”
“夜哭怪？”刚刚回来的王磊大吃一惊！
手按佩剑神色凝重：“详细说说，它什么时候来的？害了多少人？”
“就是三天前，那三个坏人进村之后没多久，它就来了。”
老奶奶浑身发抖，“每天半夜三更，全村都能听见小孩子的哭声，然后谁家的娃就会凭空失踪……”

“已经丢了两个男娃了！还有好几户大人，早上起来浑身发软，像是被抽走了半条命，连床都下不来……”
“我们开始以为是那三个坏人勾结的邪祟，质问过他们孩子在哪儿？可他们却赌咒发誓说不知道。后来我们不敢声张，也不敢去找，只能每天晚上把门窗钉死，抱着孩子躲在被子里发抖……”
周围的村民听到这话，脸上的喜色瞬间褪去，纷纷围上来点头附和：
“是啊仙长！那怪物来了之后，全村人每晚都做噩梦，醒过来浑身是冷汗！”
“我家娃昨天哭了一夜，说有个黑乎乎的毛球要咬他的影子！”
“我们敲锣打鼓、烧桃木剑都没用，它来无影去无踪，根本碰不到！”
王磊眉头紧锁：“奇怪了，我刚才净化村落的时候，完全没察觉到这股气息啊。”
蔡文姬微微细想，她刚才确实捕捉到一丝极淡、极隐蔽的黑暗波动，藏在村口老槐树的树洞里。
只是当时被三个散修的戾气掩盖，以为是残留的邪祟浊气。
现在想来，那气息根本不是凡间邪祟该有的——似乎还带着一种熟悉的、来自另一个世界的波动！
“没关系，今晚我们留下来。”
蔡文姬语气坚定：“既然遇上了，就没有不管的道理。今晚它要是敢再来，我一定把它抓住，救回失踪的孩子。”
村民们大喜过望，纷纷跪下磕头道谢。
当晚，落云村一片死寂。
家家户户门窗钉死，连一丝灯火都不敢漏。
蔡文姬和王磊坐在老槐树下。王磊横剑在膝，时刻警惕四周。
蔡文姬盘膝而坐，指尖萦绕着淡淡的金色音律，将整个村子笼罩在一层微弱的安抚屏障里。
content_en:
The turmoil in Luoyun Village has completely subsided, and the three evil cultivators did not dare to slack off.
According to the rules set by Cai Wenji, under the supervision of Wang Lei, they returned the stolen money and supplies door to door, and apologized to the villagers.
In the past, the villains who used to be fierce and fierce, and would strike with just a raised hand, are now downcast and cautious, not even daring to breathe loudly.
The grievances that the villagers had accumulated for many days were all dispelled, and they looked at the girl in green with gratitude and awe in their eyes.
Many elderly people deliberately took out the remaining crude tea and wild fruits at home and insisted on giving them to Cai Wenji to express their gratitude.
Cai Wenji declined them all. She came down the mountain to eliminate evil and accumulate merit, not to covet any feedback from mortals.
Wang Lei helped him politely decline the villagers' gifts and explained with a smile:
"Fellow folks, you don't have to be polite. It's our duty as immortal cultivators to kill demons and protect the people. You can just keep these things to replenish your health."
Cai Wenji arranged for three casual cultivators to start cleaning up the remaining evil spirits in the village, and told them to work peacefully, atone for their sins, and repent in the next six months.
Wang Lei deliberately left a message mark and said solemnly: "I will come back regularly for inspections. If you dare to violate the rules and do evil again, I will be the first to destroy your cultivation without Junior Sister Cai taking action."
The three casual cultivators nodded repeatedly, not even daring to resist.
Just when everyone thought everything was fine and were about to leave, the old woman who was crying on crutches did not leave.
She pulled on Cai Wenji's clothes, her face was pale, her lips were trembling, and her eyes were full of lingering fear.
Cai Wenji knelt down and asked softly: "Grandma, is there anything else? Are there any difficulties that haven't been discussed yet?"
The old lady looked around and confirmed that Wang Lei had escorted the three casual cultivators to the edge of the village to take care of them. He was returning quickly, then lowered his voice and leaned into her ear with a cry:
"The Immortal...and...there is something even more terrifying...it's not the three bad guys, it's a night-crying monster that can eat people..."
"Crying monster at night?" Wang Lei, who had just returned, was shocked!
He put his hand on the sword and looked solemn: "Tell me in detail, when did it come? How many people did it harm?"
"It came just three days ago, not long after those three bad guys entered the village."
The old woman was trembling all over. "At midnight every day, the whole village can hear the cry of children, and then someone's baby will disappear out of thin air..."
"Two boys have been lost! There are also several adults in the family who woke up in the morning feeling weak, as if half of their lives had been taken away, and they couldn't even get out of bed..."
"At first we thought it was the evil collusion of the three bad guys, and we asked them where the child was? But they swore that they didn't know. Later, we didn't dare to speak out, and we didn't dare to look for it. We could only nail the doors and windows shut every night, hold the child in our arms and hide under the quilt, shivering..."
When the surrounding villagers heard this, the joy on their faces instantly faded, and they all gathered around and nodded in agreement:
"Yes, Immortal! After the monster came, the whole village had nightmares every night and woke up covered in cold sweats!"
"My baby cried all night yesterday, saying that there was a black fur ball trying to bite his shadow!"
"It's no use beating gongs and drums or burning mahogany swords. It comes and goes without a trace. We can't touch it at all!"
Wang Lei frowned: "It's strange. When I purified the village just now, I didn't notice this aura at all."
Cai Wenji thought for a moment that she had indeed captured a very faint and very hidden dark wave just now, hidden in the hole of the old locust tree at the entrance of the village.
But at that time, it was covered up by the hostility of the three casual cultivators, and they thought it was the residual evil spirit.
Now that I think about it, that aura is not what evil spirits in the world should have at all - it seems to have a familiar wave from another world!
"It doesn't matter, we'll stay tonight."
Cai Wenji said firmly: "Now that we have encountered it, there is no reason to ignore it. If it dares to come again tonight, I will definitelyCatch it and rescue the missing child. "
The villagers were overjoyed and knelt down one after another to kowtow to express their thanks.
That night, there was deathly silence in Luoyun Village.
The doors and windows of every house were nailed shut, and not even a trace of light dared to leak out.
Cai Wenji and Wang Lei were sitting under the old locust tree. Wang Lei held his sword across his knees, always alert to his surroundings.
Cai Wenji sat cross-legged, with a faint golden melody lingering on her fingertips, shrouding the entire village in a weak soothing barrier.
